pattern: Static informative image: svg role="img" with a generated accessible name (WAI Images tutorial, informative images).

aria.value: Localized "{label}: {count} values, from {first} to {last}, minimum {min}, maximum {max}." (or valueText)

keyboard.action: Not focusable; the accessible name carries the summary. Use Line Chart for keyboard exploration.

notes: Meaning is carried by the accessible name and the surrounding text, not by color.
Forced colors draw the sparkline in CanvasText.
knownCaveats: Individual values are not exposed; keep the key value in visible text next to the sparkline.
